title: Santa ETA vs Bedtime Risk
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=santa:tracker
| stats latest(eta_hours) as eta_hours, latest(region) as region by tracker
| eval bedtime_risk=if(eta_hours<2,1,0)
| sort eta_hours
description: Adds a deliberately silly view of whether Santa's ETA is getting too close to bedtime.
value: Novelty metrics are still useful when they build anticipation and make the countdown feel alive.
implementation: Send Santa-tracker snapshots to `index=personal`; compute a bedtime-risk flag based on the latest ETA.
visualization: Single-value tile of Santa ETA with bedtime-risk flag.
grandmaExplanation: It maps whether Santa seems uncomfortably close to bedtime, which is exactly the kind of festive detail a countdown needs.
